function: Exoglycosidase that cleaves the single beta-linked mannose residue from the non-reducing end of beta-mannosidic oligosaccharides of various complexity and length. Involved in the degradation of polymeric mannan and galactomannan. Releases the terminal mannose residue from mannobiose and mannotriose, as well as from galactosyl-mannobiose (GM2), galactosyl-mannotriose (GM3) and di-galactosyl-mannopentaose (G2M5).
